data.title: Binance Completes Matic Network Lottery Draw and Will Open Trading For MATIC
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance has completed the Matic Network lottery draw, with a 58.38% ratio of winning tickets. The results of the lottery draw are summarized below.

No. of Digits

Tail Digits Drawn in the Lottery

No. of Winning Tickets

1 Tail Digit

4, 8, 3, 7, 9

14,273

2 Tail Digits

55, 06, 75, 80, 50, 92, 10, 05

2,283

3 Tail Digits

482, 501, 282

87

4 Tail Digits

7842, 6171, 2900, 7522, 9220, 7041, 8771,

7272

22

5 Tail Digits

25651

1
 

Total

16,666

 

Please ensure that you have sufficient BNB in your account based on the number of your winning tickets. We started deducting BNB from accounts at 2019/04/25 10:00 AM (UTC) and users will have 24 hours until 2019/04/26 10:00 AM (UTC) to credit their accounts.

The token purchase price was set at 1 MATIC = 0.000119 BNB / 0.00263 USD (using a BNB price of 22.0200 USD) as per the previous announcement here.

Binance will also open trading for MATIC/BNB, MATIC/BTC and MATIC/USDT trading pairs at 2019/04/26 3:00 PM (UTC).

Matic Network Listing Fee: 0 BNB

For a full recap of the Matic Network token sale, read our blog post here.

To learn more about the Matic Network project, read the in-depth report by Binance Research here.

Details:

  1. About Matic Network (MATIC)
  2. Fees
  3. Rules

Risk warning: Cryptocurrency investment is subject to high market risk. Please make your investments cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high quality coins, but will not be responsible for your investment losses.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2019/04/25

Telegram: https://t.me/binanceexchange
